enriched_description: Muscular medium-sized terrier measuring 43-48 cm at shoulder and weighing 18-27 kg. Head is broad and deep with pronounced cheek muscles, moderate stop, and medium-length muzzle. Ears are set high, may be cropped or natural (rose or half-pricked). Eyes are round, dark, and set wide apart with alert expression. Nose is black. Body is stocky and heavily muscled with broad chest, deep ribs, level topline, and slight tuck-up. Coat is short, close-lying, stiff, and glossy. Coloration is highly variable: solid, parti-color, or patched in any color except liver, black-and-tan, or merle. Tail is medium-length, low-set, tapering, and carried straight. Legs are straight, heavy-boned, and well-muscled with round compact feet. Gait is free, powerful, and agile. Distinguished from Staffordshire bull terrier by larger size and heavier build.

Small terrier measuring 38-43 cm at shoulder and weighing 8-10 kg. Most distinctive feature is lamb-like appearance created by unique grooming style and coat texture. Head is narrow and arched with Roman nose (convex profile) and minimal stop. Ears are moderate-sized, triangular, set low, and hanging flat with silky fringe. Eyes are small, deep-set, and triangular, color ranging from light amber to dark brown. Body is arched over loin with roached topline, deep narrow chest, and pronounced tuck-up. Coat is distinctive linty, crisp texture, a mix of hard and soft hairs, ranging from blue, sandy, liver, or blue-and-tan. Tail is moderate-length, low-set, tapering, and carried with slight curve. Legs are straight and long with hare feet. Gait is free, elastic, and springy. Untrimmed coat forms topknot on head.

Small rough-coated terrier measuring 28-41 cm at shoulder and weighing 5-7 kg. Head is otter-shaped: broad skull with moderate stop and short strong muzzle. Ears are V-shaped, medium-sized, set high, and hanging forward close to cheeks. Eyes are dark and alert with keen expression. Body is narrow and deep-chested with level topline, built for following foxes underground. Coat is double-layered: dense short undercoat with harsh wiry outer coat, close-lying and weather-resistant. Coloration is red, grizzle-and-tan, blue-and-tan, or wheaten. Dark muzzle (mask) is characteristic. Tail is moderate-length, set high, thick at base, tapering, and carried gaily. Legs are straight and moderate-length with small compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering. Narrow chest and long legs distinguish from other small terriers.

Medium-sized Irish terrier measuring 44-49 cm at shoulder and weighing 15-18 kg. Most distinctive feature is silky blue-grey coat that darkens with maturity (puppies are born black, transitioning to blue-grey by 18 months). Head is long and flat with moderate stop and strong square muzzle. Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks. Eyes are dark, small, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is well-proportioned and muscular with deep chest, level topline, and moderate tuck-up. Coat is soft, dense, wavy, and silky, never wiry, covering entire body including legs and head. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect. Legs are straight and muscular with round compact feet. Gait is free, smooth, and effortless. Entire coat should be blue-grey with darker shading on head, ears, and tail.

Medium-sized wiry-coated terrier measuring 46-48 cm at shoulder and weighing 11-12 kg. Most distinctive feature is solid rich red, red-wheaten, or golden-red coat coloration. Head is long and flat with slight stop and strong muzzle. Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks. Eyes are dark brown, small, and alert with fiery expression. Nose is black. Body is racy and well-proportioned with deep chest, level topline, and moderate tuck-up. Coat is dense, harsh, wiry, and close-lying, with slight beard and furnishings on legs. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried gaily. Legs are straight, muscular, and moderate-length with small compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering. Entire coat should be solid red with minimal white markings on chest permissible.

Small terrier measuring 23-25 cm at shoulder and weighing 5-5.5 kg. Most distinctive feature is dropped (folded) ears distinguishing from Norwich terrier. Head is slightly rounded with moderate stop and strong wedge-shaped muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, V-shaped, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks. Eyes are oval, dark, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is compact and sturdy with short back, level topline, and moderate chest. Coat is straight, wiry, hard-textured, and close-lying, ranging from red, wheaten, black-and-tan, or grizzle. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried moderately high. Legs are short, straight, and sturdy with round compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering. Dropped ears and slightly larger size distinguish from Norwich terrier.

Small short-legged terrier measuring 23-25 cm at shoulder and weighing 5-5.5 kg. Most distinctive feature is erect pointed ears distinguishing from Norfolk terrier. Head is slightly rounded with moderate stop and strong wedge-shaped muzzle. Ears are small, pointed, set high, and carried erect. Eyes are oval, dark, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is compact and sturdy with short back, level topline, and moderate chest. Coat is straight, wiry, hard-textured, and close-lying, ranging from red, wheaten, black-and-tan, or grizzle. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried moderately high. Legs are short, straight, and sturdy with round compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering. Erect ears and slightly smaller size distinguish from Norfolk terrier.

Very small toy terrier measuring 18-20 cm at shoulder and weighing 2-3 kg. Most distinctive feature is long, straight, silky coat in distinctive blue-grey and tan coloration. Head is small and flat with moderate stop and medium-length muzzle. Ears are small, V-shaped, set high, and carried erect. Eyes are medium-sized, dark, and sparkling with alert expression. Nose is black. Body is compact and well-proportioned with level topline. Coat is long, straight, glossy, and silky, parting along spine from head to tail. Coloration is steel blue on body and tail, rich golden tan on head, chest, and legs. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, carried slightly above horizontal. Legs are straight with black toenails and round compact feet. Gait is free, brisk, and animated. Coat should reach floor when untrimmed.

Medium-sized terrier measuring 36-39 cm at shoulder and weighing 7-8 kg. Head is flat and narrow with moderate stop and strong muzzle. Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks. Eyes are dark, small, round, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black. Body is compact and well-balanced with deep chest, level topline, and slight tuck-up. Coat is dense, harsh, wiry outer coat with softer undercoat, standing off from body. Coloration is predominantly white with black, tan, or black-and-tan markings. Body should be mostly white with colored markings on head and hindquarters. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried gaily. Legs are straight, muscular, and moderate-length with small compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering. Wiry coat texture distinguishes from smooth fox terrier.

Small wire-haired terrier measuring 34-37 cm at shoulder and weighing 7-8 kg. Head is flat and moderately broad with slight stop and strong muzzle. Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks. Eyes are dark hazel or brown, small, and alert with keen expression. Nose is black (liver in liver-colored dogs). Body is compact and well-balanced with deep chest, level topline, and moderate tuck-up. Coat is dense, harsh, wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant. Coloration is blue, black, liver, red, orange, wheaten, red-grizzle, blue-grizzle, or tan. Dark saddle pattern common. Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried gaily. Legs are straight, muscular, and moderate-length with small compact feet. Gait is free, active, and ground-covering. Smaller and more refined than Welsh terrier.
